commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, os
x=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
p=pathlib.Path('probe'); p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def wr(name,b): (p/name).write_bytes(b)
def run(label,*args,input=None):
 r=subprocess.run([x,*args],input=input,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 print('\\n---',label,'exit',r.returncode); print('OUT',repr(r.stdout)); print('ERR',repr(r.stderr))
wr('stats.csv',b'h\\n1\\n2\\n3\\n')
wr('freq.csv',b'h\\nb\\na\\nc\\nb\\na\\n')
wr('table.csv','h1,h2\\nabcdef,a\\na,世界\\n'.encode())
wr('quote.csv',b'a,b\\n\"x,y\",\"q\"\"z\"\\n')
run('stats','stats','--everything',str(p/'stats.csv'))
run('stats nulls','stats','--everything','--nulls',str(p/'stats.csv'))
run('freq desc all','frequency','-l','0',str(p/'freq.csv'))
run('freq asc all','frequency','-l','0','--asc',str(p/'freq.csv'))
run('table default','table',str(p/'table.csv'))
run('table widthpad','table','-w','5','-p','1',str(p/'table.csv'))
run('table condense','table','-c','3',str(p/'table.csv'))
run('fmt quote escape','fmt','--quote',\"'\",'--escape','\\\\',str(p/'quote.csv'))
run('fmt ascii','fmt','--ascii',str(p/'quote.csv'))
run('search invalid','search','[',str(p/'quote.csv'))
run('count stdin','count',input=b'h\\na\\nb\\n')
run('missing','count','no-such.csv')
run('noargs')
'@ | python -"
